info.name: Campions API - Auth, Branches, Employees, Members and CRM
info.description: Login first; accessToken is saved automatically. Includes authentication, branch, employee and all nine Member Management endpoints. Set ID/date/profile variables deliberately and send modifying requests individually. Optional auth tests intentionally exercise errors. CRM folders cover all 19 Lead/follow-up routes. Send writes individually; conversion creates a Member, not a subscription/payment.

request.description: Use any username here. On success the script automatically saves accessToken for Current user.
Send Login first. The saved collection accessToken is sent automatically; no copying/pasting.

exec: if (!savedAuthToken) { throw new Error("Send 1. Login successfully first."); }

item.name: 3. Branch management
item.description: Manual requests, not a safe whole-collection runner workflow. Requires Branches.View/Manage plus branch scope. Creating a branch requires Branches.AccessAll. Set cityId from an existing active City; no City creation endpoint exists. PUT is a complete settings update; set isActive false to deactivate. No DELETE endpoint exists.

request.description: Branches.View. Scoped users see only their current branch; explicitly global users see all branches.
Branches.View plus scope on branchId.
Branches.Manage and Branches.AccessAll required. Set cityId to an existing active city. Success saves the created ID into collection branchId.
Branches.Manage plus scope. Set branchId/cityId and all intended settings. Change isActive to false for soft deactivation; historical data is preserved.

item.name: 4. Employee branch assignments and transfers
item.description: Management requests modify real development data: send individually to the intended employee. employeeId must reference an existing Employee; this feature provides no Employee CRUD. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD in the configured gym calendar timezone, today or later. Transfers require a date after the current assignment start, both branch scopes, and an active target. Set targetBranchId deliberately; it is never auto-selected.

request.description: Employees.View plus scope on employee current branch, or global access. Unassigned employee can produce 204 for an authorized global user.
Employees.View plus scope on employee current branch, or global access.
Employees.Manage plus target scope. Set branchId and assignmentStartDate. Requires active employee/branch and no overlapping history. Use transfer for a currently assigned employee.

Employees.Transfer and scope on both branches. Cross-branch transfer requires explicit global access under the current conservative policy. Set employeeId, targetBranchId and transferEffectiveDate. Existing business transaction branches remain unchanged.
Employees.View. Add optional search, branchId, status and employmentType query parameters. totalCount is before paging.
Employees.View plus branch scope. totalCount gives assigned count; add status=Active to count active employees only.
Employees.View plus scope; no payroll or Identity secrets.
Employees.Manage plus scope. Remove initialBranchId only for globally authorized unassigned creation. No login account is created. Returned ID replaces employeeId.
Employees.Manage plus scope. Full profile body; retain current values. No branch/account/status fields.
Employees.Manage plus scope. Active, Suspended or Resigned (existing ended-employment name). Resigned sets termination date; Active clears it.

item.name: 6. Member management
item.description: All nine Member routes, with three alternative create examples. Select one creation workflow; send writes individually. Login first with the required permissions. Configure actual branch CountryCallingCode for local phone input; international + input is also supported. No subscriptions or payments are created.

request.description: Members.View plus registration-branch scope. Enable optional filters as needed. ClientCode is branch-local; pair it with registrationBranchId. Cross-branch ownership alone does not grant browsing access.
Members.View plus registration-branch scope. Includes current owner, derived House state, employee link and lightweight Freelance eligibility.

item.name: Create normal Sales member / cross-branch referral

request.description: Members.Create and Members.OwnSalesCustomers; current active linked employee becomes owner automatically. Set memberRegistrationBranchId to an active target. Another branch additionally requires Members.CreateCrossBranch; no employee transfer or broader access is granted. Successful creation saves memberId. Set a unique valid memberPrimaryPhone before sending.

item.name: Create member with management-selected Sales owner

request.description: Members.Create and Members.AssignSales plus target branch scope. salesEmployeeId must identify an active employee/user with Members.OwnSalesCustomers. Manager does not need ownership capability. Successful creation saves memberId. Set a unique valid memberPrimaryPhone before sending.

Members.Create and FreelancePlans.ManageEligibleMembers plus target branch scope. Plan/coach must be eligible for target branch city. Creates eligibility without Sales assignment, subscription or payment. Successful creation saves memberId. Set a unique valid memberPrimaryPhone before sending.

Members.Edit plus branch scope; primary-phone changes additionally require Members.ChangePrimaryPhone. Full profile replacement: retain real values from details. Id, ClientCode, registration branch and ownership cannot be updated here.
Members.ChangeStatus plus branch scope. Set isActive true to reactivate. No deletion; all history remains.
Members.View plus branch scope. House has no current assignment (204 or null response).
Members.ViewSalesHistory plus branch scope. Previous assignments remain preserved.
Members.AssignSales plus member branch scope. Target active employee/user needs Members.OwnSalesCustomers; may work in another branch. Closes previous assignment and preserves history.
Members.AssignSales plus member branch scope. Closes current assignment without deleting history; no new assignment is created.

item.name: 7. CRM Leads
item.description: All 14 Lead routes plus explicit Lost/reactivation and normal/Freelance conversion alternatives. Login first, set variables, and send modifying requests individually. Converted is terminal. Managers need distribution authority; Sales eligibility is separate.

item.name: List, search and filter visible Leads

request.description: Leads.View. Sales see assigned Leads across transfers; Leads.Assign managers see scoped branch Leads plus personally owned Leads. Enable optional filters; no branch bypass.
Leads.View. Authenticated employee only. Add status=Lost or Converted for historical view, followUp=Today/Overdue/Upcoming for scheduling.

Leads.View and active operational branch scope. Member first, then Lead, then NotFound. Inaccessible private details are withheld. Active employees with Leads.Convert + Members.Create receive ExistingLeadId for phone-selected conversion only. Script URL-encodes + input correctly.
Leads.View and owner/management branch scope.
Leads.Manage. Leads.Assign manager creates unassigned Lead; eligible Sales self-owns. fullName is optional for phone-only intake. Successful Created saves leadId.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.result === "Created" && body.lead) pm.collectionVariables.set("leadId", body.lead.id); }

request.description: Leads.Assign + Leads.Manage; 1–100 rows. Created/AlreadyMember/AlreadyLead/Invalid per row. These examples include a phone-only prospect; choose distinct real test phones.
Leads.Manage and owner/management scope. Retain real profile values. Branch, owner, lifecycle and normalized phone are protected. Converted profiles use Member API.
Leads.Assign. Target active Sales account needs Members.OwnSalesCustomers and current primary operational branch assignment. Old assignment is closed, not overwritten.
Leads.View; unassigned/converted current assignment can be 204/null.
Leads.View plus scope; ended assignments remain.
Leads.Manage; active linked employee and owner/management scope. Call, WhatsApp, Visit, Other. Set future ISO8601 leadNextFollowUpAt; contact time defaults to now.
Leads.View; append-only history and pagination.
Leads.Manage; records loss and clears current schedule, preserves history/assignment.
Leads.Manage + Leads.Assign; preserves history. Use FollowUp with a future date after prior contact.

Leads.Convert + Members.Create and active linked employee; authorized non-owners may register without assignment grants. Lead owner is preserved; converter is audit/creation actor. Normal conversion needs an assigned eligible owner. Destination outside actor current branch requires Members.CreateCrossBranch. No arbitrary owner, subscription or payment. Preserves canonical Lead phone; saves memberId.

item.name: Convert explicit Freelance special offer to House

request.description: Alternative to normal conversion. Also requires FreelancePlans.ManageEligibleMembers and destination scope. Eligible plan/coach/city required. Explicitly overrides Lead owner with audited House; creates eligibility only.

item.name: 8. CRM Member follow-ups
item.description: Five follow-up routes. Current Member ownership determines queues; House work needs management distribution. No automatic lifecycle detection, payments or notifications.

request.description: CRM.ViewMemberFollowUps; authenticated employee only. Lead items additionally require Leads.View. Add window=Today/Overdue/Upcoming or branchId. Includes owned cross-branch Members without expanding Member browsing.
CRM.ManageHouseFollowUps; branch-scoped management queue. Add window or branchId filters.

CRM.ManageMemberFollowUps. Owner (including cross-branch) or Members.AssignSales manager in scope. One open Member/reason task; saves crmFollowUpId. Tasks are explicit; no automatic expiry/attendance generation.
CRM.ManageMemberFollowUps; current owner or scoped Members.AssignSales manager. Preserves task history.
CRM.ManageHouseFollowUps + Members.AssignSales; open House work in scope. Invokes existing Member assignment/history and validates owner capability. Work dynamically moves to new owner.

item.name: 9. Membership Plans
item.description: All 20 canonical routes, with alternative plan create examples. Send writes individually; configure actual IDs first. BranchId administration differs from CityId access. No purchase/grant requests.

request.description: MembershipPlans.View; current active branch only, or any branch with Branches.AccessAll. Employee plans hidden unless administrative opt-in.
MembershipPlans.View; Employee details also require MembershipPlans.Manage.
MembershipPlans.Manage; explicit active owning branch. Audience category may be null or an active category ID. No subscription/payment.
MembershipPlans.Manage; valid active Freelance Coach, fixed gym price. No Sales ownership created.
MembershipPlans.Manage; free internal Unlimited duration-zero product. No subscription grant.
MembershipPlans.Manage; send full matching behavioral type. Historical subscriptions unchanged.
MembershipPlans.Manage; existing subscriptions remain unchanged. Send true to reactivate after validating configuration.
MembershipPlans.View; own branch scope.
MembershipPlans.Manage; full replacement, maximum 100 distinct entries. Access uses quantity:null. Empty benefits removes template relationships only.
FreelancePlans.ManageEligibleMembers; plan owning branch controls administration.

FreelancePlans.ManageEligibleMembers. Exactly one memberId, memberCode or phone. Replace query for exact phone/code lookup; encode + as %2B. No broad name search. Member may be registered in another branch.
FreelancePlans.ManageEligibleMembers; active Freelance plan/Coach/Member. Idempotent boolean result; Sales ownership unchanged.
FreelancePlans.ManageEligibleMembers; removes current eligibility only, preserves subscriptions/history/ownership.

item.name: 10. Global audience categories
item.description: Shared catalog writes require global access plus management permission.

request.description: MembershipPlans.View; shared catalog.
MembershipPlans.Manage + Branches.AccessAll only.
MembershipPlans.Manage + Branches.AccessAll only.
MembershipPlans.Manage + Branches.AccessAll only; referenced history retained.

item.name: 11. Global membership benefits
item.description: Shared catalog writes require global access plus management permission.

request.description: MembershipPlans.View; shared catalog.
MembershipPlans.View.
MembershipPlans.Manage + Branches.AccessAll only.
MembershipPlans.Manage + Branches.AccessAll; subscription snapshots retain old names/codes.
MembershipPlans.Manage + Branches.AccessAll; historical grants retained.

item.name: 12. Freelance plan compatibility
item.description: Four existing configuration routes now share branch-scoped validation. No purchase/report workflow added.

request.description: FreelancePlans.Manage; same branch ownership validation. Prefer canonical Membership Plan API. Compatibility enum accessMode: 0=Unlimited, 1=SessionBased.
FreelancePlans.Manage; explicit branch required; audience/freeze preserved. Compatibility enum accessMode: 0=Unlimited, 1=SessionBased.
FreelancePlans.ManageEligibleMembers; same plan branch scope and cross-registration eligibility.
FreelancePlans.ManageEligibleMembers; preserves history.

item.name: Optional automated test cases
item.description: Extra test examples calling the same two endpoints. Some deliberately expect 400/401. Not needed for manual login.

exec: pm.test("Employee, branch and permissions resolved", () => { pm.expect(authResponse.employeeId).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(authResponse.currentBranch.name).to.eql("Auth Demo Branch"); pm.expect(authResponse.permissions).to.include("Payments.Create"); });
